$comment: D-RUNTIME-MAIN-ENVP-ENTRY-SHAPE: the RUN witness for Darwin's four-parameter `int main(int, char**, char**, char**)` -- dyld calls LC_MAIN with (argc, argv, envp, apple) in the first four argument registers. The Mach-O formats realize the `argc-argv-envp-apple` verb by pass-through (nothing emitted), so the entry trampoline's one obligation is to keep all four registers intact across the before-entry static initializers; the `__attribute__((constructor))` here CALLS a four-argument function between dyld's call and `main`, which makes a short park observable. The program checks structure and independent agreement, never content: envp against getenv, apple distinct from envp and carrying an `executable_path=` entry (see main.c for the exit-code ladder, 90..97). DARWIN-ONLY: no ELF or pe loader hands an entry a fourth vector, so the same source is refused there (entry_main_apple_refused_off_darwin). RED-ON-DISABLE: park two argument registers instead of the format-derived four -> 92..97 on both Mach-O legs; drop "argc-argv-envp-apple" from a Mach-O format's `entryVerbs` -> K_ProgramEntryUndefined.
